title: Creating and working with Python lists

cues.en: In several previous videos in this course I have mentioned the variable type of a list.
cues.zh: 前面幾段影片提過串列型別，

cues.en: So you've already gotten a bit of an introduction into lists in Python but in this video I want to take
cues.zh: 你已經稍微認識 Python 串列，但這段想花點，

cues.en: a few moments to tell you more about lists -- how they work, how to create them, how to work with them, how
cues.zh: 時間，多介紹它的運作、建立、使用方式，以及如何，

cues.en: to store different kinds of data in a list... and that's also going to lead to a discussion of slicing, a procedure in Python called slicing.
cues.zh: 存放不同資料。這也會帶到 Python 所謂的切片。

cues.en: So let's begin. I'm going to have a list and lists are indicated in Python with square brackets like
cues.zh: 開始吧。建立串列，要像這樣用中括號，

cues.en: this and then you can have commas separating the different elements of the list.
cues.zh: 再用逗號隔開不同元素。

cues.en: So here is a list.
cues.zh: 這是一份串列。

cues.en: Let's see what it looks like when I print it out. So, well print it out.
cues.zh: 印出來看看，

cues.en: It's not terribly interesting.
cues.zh: 沒什麼特別，

cues.en: It's literally just exactly what I typed but with an extra space and we can also see that the type or the class is a list.
cues.zh: 就是輸入的內容，多了一點空白，也能看到型別、類別是 list。

cues.en: So this function type will print out the variable type or the class of the input.
cues.zh: type 函數會提供輸入的變數型別或類別。

cues.en: So this is a list. To access individual elements within a list,
cues.zh: 這是串列。要存取個別元素，

cues.en: you also use square brackets, so the square brackets to create a list and square brackets to access elements in a list.
cues.zh: 也用中括號。所以建立用中括號，存取也用中括號。

cues.en: Now you always have to keep in mind with Python that Python starts counting at zero.
cues.zh: 一定要記住，Python 從 0 開始計數。

cues.en: So if I try to access element 3 here, that's actually the fourth element and that's because this is the
cues.zh: 如果取索引 3，其實是第四個元素，因為這裡是，

cues.en: zero-th element, the first element, the second element, and the third element.
So therefore I expect that list item number three.
cues.zh: 因此我預期，第 3 號，

cues.en: Or with index 3 corresponds to the number 7.
cues.zh: 也就是索引 3，對應數字 7。

cues.en: Likewise, if I were to say 1 here, that's actually the second element in this list.
cues.zh: 如果這裡放 1，其實是第二個元素，

cues.en: So that's going to be the number three because this is the zero-th item in the list, and this is the first item in the list.
cues.zh: 就是 3，因為這是第 0 號，這是第 1 號。

cues.en: Now if you want to access the last item in the list you can also use a minus one.
cues.zh: 要最後一個項目，也能用 -1，

cues.en: That's a special procedure in Python that will immediately go to the end of the list.
cues.zh: 這是 Python 的特殊用法，直接取最後一個。

cues.en: Now this is pretty useful because when you have the list printed out like this, I can just see that there are four numbers so if I want the last number it's really easy just to type three.
cues.zh: 很方便。串列印出來時，看得到四個數字，要最後一個，輸入 3 很容易，

cues.en: However, if this list were longer, or maybe this list was something that I imported from a dataset then I might not necessarily know how long it is immediately.
cues.zh: 但如果串列很長，或來自匯入的資料集，不一定立刻知道長度，

cues.en: So it's pretty convenient to be able to access the final item of a list by just using minus one.
cues.zh: 因此用 -1 取得最後一個很方便。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And that is going to lead into a discussion of slicing.
cues.zh: 這就帶到切片，

cues.en: So this is called slicing variables in Python.
cues.zh: Python 裡變數的切片。

cues.en: So here I showed you how to access one single element.
cues.zh: 剛才示範單一元素，

cues.en: What if we want to access more elements?
cues.zh: 如果要多個呢？

cues.en: For example, what if I want to get the first two elements here?
cues.zh: 例如想要前兩個，

cues.en: So the first element and the second element, corresponding to values 1 and 3.
cues.zh: 第一個、第二個，值是 1、3，

cues.en: So what you can do here is use the colon and then two, and now this will print out one comma three.
cues.zh: 可以用冒號，再放 2，就印出 1、3。

cues.en: And the idea of this syntax here is that you're saying all of the elements from the beginning up and to the index corresponding to this number minus one.
cues.zh: 語法意思是，從開頭，一直到指定數字減 1 的索引。

cues.en: So from the beginning and then moving up for two elements gives us the zero-th element and the first
cues.zh: 從頭取兩個，就是第 0 號、第 1，

cues.en: element, and you can also do this with variables, so I could say n equals 2 and then give me list from the beginning up until 2.
cues.zh: 號。也能用變數，設定 n=2，再取從頭到 2 之前。

cues.en: So this would be slicing, to print out the first N elements. And if you wanted to do slicing to print
cues.zh: 這就是切片，印出前 n 個。如果想，

cues.en: out the final, let's call this K elements, just to use a different variable from n here.
cues.zh: 印出最後 k 個，這次用另一個變數，不用 n，

cues.en: So I can say k equals, Let's also stick with two. And I'm going to say list minus K and then colon, and this will print out the last
cues.zh: k 也設 2。寫串列[-k:]，就能印出最後，

cues.en: two elements of this list.
cues.zh: 兩個，

cues.en: So that's 6 and 7.
cues.zh: 也就是 6、7。

cues.en: So again now the principle of this syntax is that I'm going from the end minus two.
cues.zh: 這個語法的原則，是從結尾往前兩個，

cues.en: So the second to last element, this would be the first last element and here is the well k-th last element here it's two. Up until the end.
cues.zh: 也就是倒數第二個，這是倒數第一個，這是倒數第 k 個，這裡 k=2，再一路到最後。

cues.en: So now I've shown you how to slice for the first N elements and for the final k elements. Of course
cues.zh: 現在示範了前 n 個，以及最後 k 個。當然，

cues.en: you can get from any arbitrary N to any arbitrary K. And to do that I actually want to make this list a little bit longer.
cues.zh: 也能從任意 n 到任意 k。為了示範，把串列加長。

cues.en: So I would say just put in some random numbers.
cues.zh: 隨便多放幾個數字，

cues.en: This is going to give me an error here and this will also give me an error.
cues.zh: 這裡會出錯，那裡也會，

cues.en: Let's do zero there.
cues.zh: 這邊放 0。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: I run this cell again.
cues.zh: 重新執行。

cues.en: Basically I just want more elements inside this list and now what I want to do is access.
cues.zh: 只是想讓串列多一些元素，再存取，

cues.en: Let's say I want to get these elements in here.
cues.zh: 例如想要中間這些，

cues.en: So now I have a lowercase n equals three, and K equals seven.
cues.zh: 設定小寫 n=3、k=7，

cues.en: So by combining this syntax with this and syntax, we can write list from n through K and actually let
cues.zh: 結合兩種語法，寫串列[n:k]。其實，讓我，

cues.en: me copy actually I'll just print that out again.
cues.zh: 複製，其實再印一次就好。

cues.en: So let's see.
cues.zh: 看看，

cues.en: Print out the full list and then we can see what elements we have here.
cues.zh: 先印完整串列，才知道有哪些元素。

cues.en: So remember this the zero with element and then element 1 2 3.
cues.zh: 記得，這是第 0 號，再來 1、2、3，

cues.en: And that's where we started.
cues.zh: 從這裡開始。

cues.en: So n equals three starts at seven up to element K minus one.
cues.zh: n=3，從數字 7 開始，到索引 k-1，

cues.en: So this seven here is element three.
cues.zh: 這個數字 7 是索引 3，

cues.en: And then we have four five six.
cues.zh: 再來索引 4、5、6，

cues.en: And then this will be the seventh element.
cues.zh: 這個則是索引 7。

cues.en: And so this syntax means just go up to the element just preceding this, what we specify here.
cues.zh: 所以語法表示，只到指定元素之前，

cues.en: So in this case the number seven.
cues.zh: 這裡指定的是索引 7。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this is about making lists of numbers.
cues.zh: 以上是數字串列，

cues.en: And for a course on using Python to understand mathematics of course it makes sense.
cues.zh: 對用 Python 學數學的課程，當然很合理。

cues.en: But I also want to point out to you that lists are not confined to numbers.
cues.zh: 但串列不只限於數字。

cues.en: So for example I can create a new variable called words and let's call this.
cues.zh: 例如建立新變數 words，內容，

cues.en: Hello my name is Mike maybe that should be capital.
cues.zh: Hello、my、name、is、Mike，這裡應該大寫。

cues.en: Okay so now I have a list.
cues.zh: 好，這是一份串列，

cues.en: This is still a list just like this was a list but this list now contains strings instead of containing numbers.
cues.zh: 仍然是 list，但內容是字串，不是數字。

cues.en: So now what I'm going to do is access each individual element of this list in a for loop.
cues.zh: 接著用 for，存取每個元素，

cues.en: Let's say for I in words print i.
cues.zh: 寫 for i in words，再 print(i)，

cues.en: So now this loop, this for loop, is going to go through all of the individual elements and then it's just going to print them.
cues.zh: 迴圈會走訪每個元素，直接印出來，

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 像這樣，

cues.en: Hello my name is Mike.
cues.zh: Hello my name is Mike。

cues.en: So this is one way, now the indexing variable is actually each of these cells.
cues.zh: 這是一種方式，目前迴圈變數其實是每個項目本身。

cues.en: I just want to show you how to set this up slightly differently, so that i -- this indexing variable -- can be a number instead of the entire string.
cues.zh: 再示範稍微不同的設定，讓 i 是數字，而不是整個字串。

cues.en: So we can do for i in range 0 to the length of words.
cues.zh: 寫 for i in range(0,len(words))，

cues.en: So now I'm creating a range of numbers that starts from zero and goes up to however long this thing is.
cues.zh: 產生從 0 到串列長度所決定的範圍，

cues.en: Now if I print i, you can see that this is going to print the numbers 0 through 4.
cues.zh: 如果 print(i)，會印出 0 到 4。

cues.en: So now if I want to print these individual words I can say words and then in square brackets like this the index i.
cues.zh: 要印個別單字，就寫 words，中括號裡放索引 i，

cues.en: So this is now the i-th index into this list words.
cues.zh: 取出 words 的第 i 號元素。

cues.en: So now you've seen that lists can contain numbers, a list can contain strings, and it gets even better
cues.zh: 現在知道，串列能放數字，也能放字串，還有更好的，

cues.en: than that, because a list can contain multiple different kinds of information.
cues.zh: 同個串列能放不同種類的資訊，

cues.en: All in the same list.
cues.zh: 全部放在一起。

cues.en: So let's create a new list.
cues.zh: 建立新串列，

cues.en: I'll call this alist and let's have elements 1 and 2 and then a string.
cues.zh: 叫 alist，放 1、2，再放字串，

cues.en: I don't know how about cookies because maybe I'm a little bit hungry at this point... and then I'm actually going to create the last element in this list to be another list.
cues.zh: 例如 cookies，我可能有點餓。最後一個元素，則放另一個串列，

cues.en: So let's say six comma four.
So notice I have a list that is actually an item inside a list.
cues.zh: 注意，這份串列裡的一個項目，本身也是串列，

cues.en: So it's a list inside of a list.
cues.zh: 串列裡面有串列。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And so to see what that looks like I'm going to use a for loop.
cues.zh: 用 for 看看外觀，

cues.en: So for i in a list and then I'm just going to print out each of these items.
cues.zh: for i in alist，印出每個項目。

cues.en: So here you see the number one.
cues.zh: 看到數字 1，

cues.en: Number two these string cookies and then the list itself.
cues.zh: 數字 2、字串 cookies，再來是串列本身，

cues.en: Six comma four.
So that leads to the question of how you would index for example the six?
cues.zh: 那麼，怎麼用索引取得 6？

cues.en: How do you find the six here?
cues.zh: 要怎麼找到它？

cues.en: So we know that this is the final element of a list.
cues.zh: 知道它在 alist 最後一個元素裡，

cues.en: So I can write a list and then minus one.
cues.zh: 所以寫 alist[-1]，

cues.en: And that's going to give me the result that this is another list on its own.
cues.zh: 結果是另一份獨立的串列。

cues.en: So now we need to access the first element of this list, which is a member of this list.
cues.zh: 現在要存取這份串列的第一個元素，而它又屬於外面的串列，

cues.en: So the way to do that in Python is to use again square brackets afterwards.
cues.zh: Python 的做法，是後面再加中括號，

cues.en: So we have a square bracket to access the final element in a list and then from this result we want
cues.zh: 前一組取得 alist 的最後元素，再對這個結果，

cues.en: to use another set of square brackets like this to access the zero-th element or the first element here and that is going to be six.
cues.zh: 用另一組中括號取第 0 號，也就是第一個，得到 6。

cues.en: And of course if you would write one here then we would get four because this is the second element of the list, which is the final element of this larger list. It gets a little confusing to talk about.
cues.zh: 這裡改成 1，就得到 4，因為是內層串列的第二個元素，而內層又是大串列最後的元素。說起來有點繞，

cues.en: But I think you get the idea. Here is your exercise for this video.
cues.zh: 但你應該懂。以下是練習。

cues.en: What you want to do is implement these three expressions using sympy.
cues.zh: 用 SymPy 實作這三個運算式，

cues.en: But then I want you to put each of these three into a list. In python, a few moments ago, I showed you how to make a list out of numbers out of strings out of a combination of numbers and strings and even
cues.zh: 再把三者放進串列。剛才示範過，串列能放數字、字串、兩者混合，甚至，

cues.en: other lists.
cues.zh: 其他串列，

cues.en: And now what you're going to do is create a list in Python where each element of the list is an entire
cues.zh: 現在要建立一份串列，每個元素都是完整的，

cues.en: sympy expression. And it's going to be these expressions and then what you want to do is using a for loop.
cues.zh: SymPy 運算式，也就是這些。接著用 for，

cues.en: Expand these expressions and print out the simplified version of these expressions using LaTeX and make a nice looking format.
cues.zh: 展開，並用 LaTeX 印出化簡後的形式，排版漂亮一點。

cues.en: Eventually it's going to look something like this.
cues.zh: 最後像這樣，

cues.en: You have this expression up here and when you expand it, that this gets reduced to this.
cues.zh: 上面原式，展開後變成這裡，

cues.en: And so you see each of these expressions and each of their simplifications using the expand function the expand function in sympy.
cues.zh: 能看到每個式子，以及使用 SymPy 的 expand 得到的化簡形式。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now is your opportunity to pause the video, work through this assignment.
cues.zh: 請暫停，自己完成作業。

cues.en: And now I'm going to switch to Python and show you how I solved this.
cues.zh: 接著切到 Python，示範解法。

cues.en: So I believe we haven't yet imported the sympy module. So that's actually the first thing I'm going to do.
cues.zh: 我想還沒匯入 SymPy，所以先做這件事，

cues.en: Let's see.
cues.zh: 看看，

cues.en: Import sympy as sym.
cues.zh: import sympy as sym，

cues.en: And then we need to create a symbolic variable so I can say X equals symbols and then x.
cues.zh: 再建立符號變數 x，呼叫 symbols('x')。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I'm going to write out these expressions, so e one expression was 1 was 2 x plus X times 4 minus
cues.zh: 寫出運算式，e1 是 2x，加 x 乘以括號裡的 4 減，

cues.en: 6 x plus another X and then we had e 2 that was minus X times 2 divided by X plus 4 divided by.
cues.zh: 6x，再加一個 x；e2 是負 x，乘以括號裡的 2 除以 x，加 4 除以，

cues.en: Now here you have to be careful because the denominator was X squared.
cues.zh: 這裡要小心，分母是 x 平方。

cues.en: And now the question is whether python is going to know to put these square term in the denominator or whether python is going to implement this like this.
cues.zh: 問題是，Python 是否知道平方在分母，還是會像這樣計算？

cues.en: Now to think about this we have to remember the order of operations -- that was PEMDAS, or Please excuse my dear aunt Sally.
cues.zh: 要想起運算順序，PEMDAS，Please Excuse My Dear Aunt Sally。

cues.en: So we see, first of all parentheses always takes highest priority, but exponent takes priority over division.
cues.zh: 括號最高，其次的指數也優先於除法，

cues.en: So that means that the this squared term actually will apply only to the X in the denominator and not to the four in the numerator.
cues.zh: 所以平方只套用到分母的 x，不會套用到分子的 4。

cues.en: All right so we are good here.
cues.zh: 這裡沒問題。

cues.en: That said, you know, if you think it looks nicer or easier to read with the parenthesis here, then by all means keep it there.
cues.zh: 但如果覺得加括號更漂亮、好讀，當然可以保留，

cues.en: So four over X squared.
cues.zh: 4 除以 x 平方。

cues.en: And then outside the parenthesis it was plus four plus x divided by four times x.
cues.zh: 括號外，再加上 4 加 x，除以 4 乘以 x。

cues.en: Now in this case for the numerator we definitely need the parentheses here because otherwise division is going to take priority over the additions here.
cues.zh: 這裡分子一定要括號，不然除法會優先於加法。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then we get to expression E three and that was x plus three times x minus three times x times one
cues.zh: 接著 e3，是括號 x 加 3，乘以括號 x 減 3，再乘 x，乘以 1，

cues.en: divided by nine times X. oof!
cues.zh: 除以 9 乘 x。呼，

cues.en: This is quite an eyeful here.
cues.zh: 好長一串。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I have these three separate equations.
cues.zh: 有三個獨立式子了，

cues.en: I want to put them in a list.
cues.zh: 要放進串列，

cues.en: So let's call this variable exprs.
cues.zh: 變數叫 exprs，

cues.en: And I'm going to say e one comma E two comma E three.
cues.zh: 裡面放 e1、e2、e3。

cues.en: So essentially I'm creating these three expressions up here in this part of the code.
cues.zh: 上面這一部分，分別建立三個式子，

cues.en: These expressions are separate objects, separate sympy objects.
cues.zh: 都是獨立物件、獨立 SymPy 物件，

cues.en: And now here I put them into a single list.
cues.zh: 這裡再放進同一份串列。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then what I want to do is show the original expression and then the expanded form of the expression.
cues.zh: 接著顯示原式，以及展開形式，

cues.en: So that has to be done in a for loop but before worrying about the for loop I'm gonna make sure that I can get this to work for just one element.
cues.zh: 要用 for，但先不管迴圈，確認單一元素能正常運作，

cues.en: So just one expression.
cues.zh: 也就是一個式子。

cues.en: So let's say display math and then this is going to be the expression let's call it c e 1 and then I'm
cues.zh: 呼叫 display、Math，這裡先放運算式，例如 e1，再，

cues.en: going to need some kind of an arrow here and then e one again.
cues.zh: 需要某種箭頭，接著又是 e1。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now let's start doing some replacement.
cues.zh: 開始替換，

cues.en: So this is going to be.
cues.zh: 這裡是，

cues.en: Percent s.
And then here another percent s.
cues.zh: 這裡再一個 %s，

cues.en: And now we want to replace these with two strings.
cues.zh: 用兩個字串取代，

cues.en: This is going to be sympy latex so the latex version of E one and then the same that latex.
cues.zh: 一個是 sym.latex(e1)，也就是 e1 的 LaTeX；另一個也用 sym.latex，

cues.en: I need a dot there.
cues.zh: 這裡需要點號，

cues.en: sym dot latex of the expanded version.
cues.zh: 傳入展開後的版本，

cues.en: Expand of E 1.
cues.zh: 也就是 expand(e1)。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。
